import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/check_types_builtin_json.c","function":"UA_DataTypeAttributes_json_decode","line":5486,"var":"buf","code":"UA_ByteString buf = UA_STRING(\"{\\\"SpecifiedAttributes\\\":1,...}\");","note":"The attacker-controlled JSON is decoded directly into a DataTypeAttributes structure containing nested LocalizedText members.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/check_types_builtin_json.c","function":"UA_DataTypeAttributes_json_decode","line":5495,"var":"out.displayName / out.description","code":"UA_StatusCode retval = UA_decodeJson(&buf, &out, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_DATATYPEATTRIBUTES]);","note":"Decoding populates two heap-backed LocalizedText fields plus scalar metadata, creating nested ownership to be released later.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buf"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"LocalizedText_decodeJson","line":2226,"var":"dst->locale / dst->text","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_LOCALE, &dst->locale, (decodeJsonSignature) String_decodeJson, false, NULL}, {UA_JSONKEY_TEXT, &dst->text, (decodeJsonSignature) String_decodeJson, false, NULL}","note":"Each LocalizedText field allocates separate locale/text strings from the attacker-controlled JSON.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"nested LocalizedText"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->locale / p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"Cleanup of each LocalizedText frees both string members, so any alias or repeated ownership becomes dangerous here.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"deleteMembers"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"The string buffer is released through the generic array deleter, which is the first free in the chain.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"freed string buffer"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"The generic clear dispatcher walks the decoded object graph and invokes the nested frees on the attacker-controlled structure.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"control","via":"dispatcher"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"The second LocalizedText member is cleared after the first one, so a stale alias to the same heap buffer would now be dangling.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"dangling alias"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->locale / p->text","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"The root cause hypothesis is that JSON decoding can construct nested LocalizedText values whose cleanup later touches already-freed string storage.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"data","via":"ownership mismatch"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":139,"var":"s->data","code":"UA_Array_delete(s->data, s->length, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_BYTE]);","note":"A second access to the same string storage during cleanup is the memory-safety sink, matching the reported heap-use-after-free read.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"dangling string alias"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"LocalizedText_clear","line":796,"var":"p->description","code":"String_clear(&p->locale, NULL); String_clear(&p->text, NULL);","note":"The same cleanup pattern repeats for the Description field, so the final sink can occur while freeing the second nested LocalizedText member.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"control","via":"second nested field"}]}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
